AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Owner Transaction Identification
AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction as known by the account owner. Will be used in a unilateral split to provide the executing party with the account owner identification of each split transaction.

ClassificationType.name: Classification Type
ClassificationType.definition: Type of instrument involved in the transactions on which the modification request should apply.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Identification of the financial instrument to which the modification request applied.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Quantity of financial instrument concerned by the settlement condition modification request.

EffectiveDate.name: Effective Date
EffectiveDate.definition: Date/time when the request should take effect.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Date/time when the request should cease to be in effect.

Investor.name: Investor
Investor.definition: Party, either an individual or organisation, whose assets are being invested.

DeliveringParty1.name: Delivering Party 1
DeliveringParty1.definition: Party that, in a settlement chain, interacts with the depository.

ReceivingParty1.name: Receiving Party 1
ReceivingParty1.definition: Party that, in a settlement chain, interacts with the depository.

TransactionSubjectToBuyIn.name: Transaction Subject To Buy In
TransactionSubjectToBuyIn.definition: The transaction relates to a buy-in by the market following a delivery transaction failure.

QuantityRule.definition: If pre-agreed between account servicer and account owner, then Quantity will be used to instruct the quantity of securities that should be partially processed, for example, partially authorised.

PartyRule.definition: Investor, DeliveringParty1 and ReceivingParty1 cannot be requested to be modified using the SecuritiesSettlementConditionModificationRequest. These fields are made available in the SecuritiesSettlementConditionModificationRequest to enable the processing of the request vis-a-vis the transaction requested to be modified.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.
